contact.basis: First near-shore original DTM approach beyond the mapped crossing end.

attribution: Lands Department, Hong Kong SAR Government
method: Unmodified source sample crop and bilinear interpolation to local meter coordinates. Original ArcInfo grid, transformed through Hong Kong 1980 Grid.
limitations: The published 5 m grid is approximate at a channel this size and can contain some structures. It has no surveyed channel bathymetry.
